newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates close steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates close steady in dull trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Saturday in a dull trade because of lower demand from spinners, dealers said.
The spinners had bought 237,000 bales (375 lbs each) more than last year until Thursday, one dealer said.

Textile mills bought 5.301 million bales until Thursday from the 1996/97 (July-June) crop compared to 5.063 million bales in the year-ago period, according to the state-run Cotton Export Corporation of Pakistan.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted at 2,375 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the dealer said.
